elements.label: Mixed-reality backyard scene with player and virtual effects
elements.change_other: live-action player motion with a VFX light-flare burst and warm-to-cool grade shift

pattern.description: Live-action mixed-reality footage: the player swings a virtual blaster, a lens-flare streak and particle sparks flash across the frame and the grade swings from warm red/orange to cool teal/green as virtual creatures glow.
pattern.why_premium: The virtual effects are composited with real light interaction (flare, sparks, colour spill on the player), so the MR content reads as physically present rather than overlaid.

build_hint.gsap: Not a UI build. Approximate with an overlay layer: gsap.fromTo('.flare', {opacity:0, x:'-30%'}, {opacity:1, x:'10%', duration:0.13, ease:'power2.out'}) then fade out; simultaneously tween a colour-grade filter on the footage (hue-rotate/saturation) over ~0.3s with 'power1.inOut'.
build_hint.remotion: Footage in <OffthreadVideo>; flare overlay opacity/translateX via interpolate(frame,[0,4,10],[0,1,0]) and a CSS filter hue-rotate interpolated across the burst; no spring needed.

notes: Live-action footage, single full-frame diff box; camera.move is none, so pan_x reflects in-frame content (player swing, flare), not a camera move. No SFX candidates.
